feeds.title: SpookyMrsGreen
feeds.description: I am Catherine Green, ghostbuster, author, mother and wife. My ghosts lurk within the human mind; my supernatural creatures are loud and proud. SpookyMrsGreen is about pagan housewife: Mindful parenting, ethical consumerism and modern pagan lifestyle.

feeds.title: The Extreme Housewife
feeds.description: Laura discusses food, wine, beer and spirits. Laura is a freelance food & drinks writer, author, and director of a creative agency.

feeds.title: Mum, Thats Me
feeds.description: This blog was founded by a UK-based mom in 2012. Its mission is to offer a friendly, relatable space for moms to find parenting advice, product reviews, and lifestyle tips. Mum, That's Me also features family-friendly recipes and travel content.

feeds.title: The Wouldbe Housewife
feeds.description: A wife and mother who has finally decided to share what I have been doing all this time. Writing posts on all things that make up my little world.
